question: How do I create a new collection?
answer: Go to the sidebar → Owner section → New Collection. Fill in the collection name, select collection type (Daily/Weekly/Monthly), configure collection days and repayment multiplier, add locations, and optionally assign employees.

question: How do I create employees before creating a collection?
answer: Go to sidebar → Owner section → Manage Employees → + New Employee. Create agents with username, password, phone, and role (Agent or Business Admin). You can then assign them when creating a collection.

question: How do I assign employees to a collection?
answer: Go to the collection's Employees page (sidebar → Employees). You'll see Assigned and Available sections. Click the checkbox next to an employee to assign them, then expand to select their village access.

question: How do I change collection settings?
answer: Go to sidebar → Settings. You can edit the collection name, collection days, repayment multiplier, grace period, defaulter period, WhatsApp template, and auto-logout time.

question: How do I delete a collection?
answer: Go to Settings → scroll to Danger Zone → Delete Collection. Type DELETE to confirm. This permanently removes all data including customers, loans, and payments.

question: How do I update my organization details?
answer: Go to My Profile → Organization Details → Edit. You can update Organization Name, Owner Name, Phone, Email, and City.

question: How do I suspend or remove an employee?
answer: Go to Manage Employees → click the three-dot menu on an employee → Suspend or Delete. Suspended employees cannot log in but their data is preserved.

question: How do I view employee password reset requests?
answer: Go to sidebar → Owner section → Employee Password Management. Pending requests appear here. Click Reset Password to set their password to their username — they'll be forced to change it on next login.

question: How do I merge duplicate customers?
answer: Go to Customers → select 2 or more customers with checkboxes → click Merge. Pick the Master record — all loans from duplicates will be moved to the Master, then duplicates are deleted. Type MERGE to confirm.

question: How do I export collection data?
answer: Go to Settings → Download Collection Data (.xlsx). This exports all data including locations, customers, loans, and payments in a single XLSX file.

question: How do I import an existing collection?
answer: Go to New Collection → Import Existing Collection → upload the exported XLSX file. Configure collection type and settings, then click Test → Import.

question: What is the difference between Owner and Business Admin roles?
answer: Owner can create/delete collections, create Business Admins, compare collections, and delete the organization. Business Admin can do everything else including creating collections, managing employees, and handling password resets.

question: What happens when I delete an organization?
answer: All collections, customers, loans, payments, employees, and the owner account are permanently deleted. This requires typing DELETE ORGANIZATION to confirm and cannot be undone. Export your data first.

question: How do I add a new customer?
answer: Go to sidebar → New Customer. Fill in required fields (Customer ID auto-generated, Full Name, Phone, Location). Additional details like Aadhaar, guarantor, and photo are optional.

question: How do I create a new loan?
answer: Go to sidebar → New Loan. Select a customer, fill in loan details (amount, interest model, installments, start date), assign an agent, and submit.

question: How do I record a payment?
answer: Go to sidebar → New Payment. Search for a customer, select the active loan, enter the amount, choose payment mode (Cash/UPI), and click Post. You can also use Post & New or Post & Next Day for faster workflow.

question: How do I do bulk posting?
answer: Go to sidebar (header) → Bulk Payments. Select a location (or All Locations), set the posting date, and enter amounts for each customer. Submit 10 at a time with Submit & Next.

question: How do I view payment history?
answer: Go to header → Payments. Filter by date range, village, or employee. The stats bar shows Paid/Unpaid counts with Expected and Collected amounts.

question: How do I edit a loan status manually?
answer: Go to Loans → select a loan → Edit → Additional Details → Loan Status dropdown. Choose Active, Overdue, Defaulter, or Completed. Setting to Active restarts the loan lifecycle from today.

question: How do I view customer details and loan history?
answer: Click on any customer name (they're clickable links everywhere). The customer profile shows total loans, amount, paid, outstanding, contact details, active loans, and completed loans.

question: What do the loan statuses mean?
answer: Active: within due date + grace period. Overdue: past grace period but within defaulter period. Defaulter: past defaulter period (configurable, default 365 days). Completed: fully paid.

question: How do I download reports?
answer: Go to Reports → select report type and date range → click View to preview, PDF to download as PDF, or XLSX for Excel. Use Share PDF/XLSX to send via WhatsApp.

question: What is the Daily Collection Summary report?
answer: A report showing all active loans for a selected date with Paid/Unpaid status. Filter by All, Paid, or Unpaid to see who paid and who didn't. Download as PDF or XLSX for field collection tracking.

question: What does the Paid/Unpaid count mean on the dashboard?
answer: Paid shows how many active loans received a payment on the selected date. Unpaid shows loans with no payment. Click Paid to view payments, click Unpaid to go to Bulk Posting for quick collection.

question: What do the dashboard stats indicate?
answer: Total Loan Amount: sum of all active loans. Repayable: total amount to be collected. Outstanding: remaining balance. Expected: today's installment total. Collected: payments received today. New Loans: loans created today.

question: How do I backdate a loan or payment?
answer: When creating a loan, change the Loan Creation Date to any past date. When recording a payment, change the Posting Date to any past date. There is no backdate limit.

question: What is the Defaulter Period and how to configure it?
answer: The number of days after the grace period ends before a loan becomes Defaulter status. Default is 365 days. Configure in Settings → Collection section → Defaulter Period (Days).

question: What is the Grace Period?
answer: Days/weeks/months after the loan end date before it becomes Overdue. During grace period, the loan stays Active. Configure per collection type in Settings.

question: What is the Repayment Multiplier?
answer: Applied to principal for ADDON interest model. e.g., 1.20 means 20% interest added to principal. So a ₹10,000 loan becomes ₹12,000 repayable. Configure in Settings.

question: How does the interest model work?
answer: Add-on: interest added to principal (₹10,000 + 20% = ₹12,000 repayable, ₹10,000 given). Upfront: interest deducted before giving (₹10,000 loan, ₹2,000 interest deducted, ₹8,000 given, ₹10,000 repayable).

question: How do I filter defaulter loans in bulk posting?
answer: In Bulk Posting, check the Defaulter checkbox next to Holiday. When unchecked (default), only Active and Overdue loans show. When checked, Defaulter loans are also included.

question: Can I record a ₹0 payment (holiday)?
answer: Yes. In Bulk Posting, check the Holiday checkbox — all amounts auto-fill to ₹0 and payment mode is set to Holiday. In Record Payment, simply enter 0 as the amount.

question: How do I renew or settle a loan?
answer: Go to the loan detail → use the action menu for Renew (creates new loan, closes old one), Early Settlement (close with reduced amount), or Write Off (mark as unrecoverable).

question: How do I change my password?
answer: Go to My Profile → expand Change Password → enter current password, new password, and confirm. Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, number, and special character.

question: I forgot my password — what do I do?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password?' on the login page → enter your username or phone number → submit. Your business owner will receive a reset request and can reset it for you.

question: What is the default password after reset?
answer: When the owner resets your password, it is automatically set to your username. You will be forced to change it on your first login.

question: How do I switch language?
answer: Go to My Profile → Language section → click English or తెలుగు. You can also switch from the login page (top-right) or the header dropdown (small toggle next to your role).

question: Why is my account suspended?
answer: Your account was suspended by the business owner or platform admin. Contact them to reactivate. Your data is preserved — nothing is deleted during suspension.

question: How do I register as a new owner?
answer: Go to the login page → click 'Sign up' → fill in Organization Name, Owner Name, Phone, Email, City, Username, and Password → Submit. The platform admin will review and approve your registration.

question: What happens when Platform Admin resets their password?
answer: Platform Admin's password is automatically reset to 'system' — no approval needed. Login with password 'system' and you'll be forced to change it immediately.

question: Can two users have the same phone number?
answer: No. During registration, the system checks if the phone number is already registered. Each phone number must be unique across all users.

question: How long does the owner session last?
answer: Owner sessions persist until you manually click Sign Out — there is no auto-logout timeout. Agents and Business Admins are auto-logged out after 30 minutes of inactivity.

question: Why was my agent account auto-logged out?
answer: Agent and Business Admin accounts have a 30-minute inactivity timeout for security. If you don't interact with the app for 30 minutes, you'll need to log in again.

question: Who can see my business data?
answer: Only you (the owner), your assigned employees (agents/business admins), and the platform admin. Other owners cannot see your data. Complete data isolation is enforced.

question: Can other owners see my customers or loans?
answer: No. Each organization's data is completely isolated. No other owner, agent, or user outside your organization can access your customers, loans, or payments.

question: Is my Aadhaar data stored securely?
answer: Yes. Aadhaar numbers are SHA-256 hashed before storage. Only the last 4 digits are stored in plain text for display purposes. The full number is never stored.

question: Can agents see other agents' data?
answer: No. Agents can only see customers and loans in their assigned villages. They cannot see other agents' collections, payments, or customer data.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Passwords are bcrypt hashed. All data in transit uses HTTPS encryption. The database runs on a private network on Oracle Cloud with no public access.

question: Are payments tamper-proof?
answer: All changes are tracked in the audit log with user ID, timestamp, old values, and new values. Deleted payments are soft-deleted (marked isDeleted) — the record is preserved for auditing.

question: Can deleted payments be recovered?
answer: Payments are soft-deleted (marked as isDeleted=true). The data is preserved in the database. Contact the platform admin for recovery if needed.

question: Who can delete customers or loans?
answer: Only Owner and Business Admin roles can delete customers or loans. Deletion requires confirmation. Agents cannot delete any data.

question: Can I recover a deleted collection?
answer: No. Collection deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Always export your data (Settings → Download Collection Data) before deleting.

question: How do I backup my data?
answer: Go to Settings → Download Collection Data (.xlsx). This exports all locations, customers, loans, and payments into a single XLSX file. We recommend regular backups.

question: Can I restore from an XLSX backup?
answer: Yes. Go to New Collection → Import Existing Collection → upload the XLSX file → Test → Import. This recreates the collection with all data from the backup.

question: What happens to data if my account is suspended?
answer: All data is preserved. Suspension only blocks login access. Once reactivated by the platform admin, all your collections, customers, loans, and payments are intact.

question: What is the system banner message?
answer: A yellow notification bar shown at the top of every page, set by the platform admin. It's used for announcements like scheduled maintenance or important updates.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Go to the sidebar → Help → Contact Us. This page shows the platform support phone, email, address, and additional notes set by the platform admin.

question: What browsers are supported?
answer: The app works on all modern browsers — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge. It's optimized for mobile browsers on Android and iOS. For the best experience, use the latest browser version.

question: Does the app work on mobile?
answer: Yes. The app is fully responsive and optimized for mobile. It works as a Progressive Web App (PWA) — you can add it to your home screen for an app-like experience.

question: How does the auto-refresh work on the dashboard?
answer: The dashboard automatically refreshes every 60 seconds to show the latest collection data. You don't need to manually reload the page.

question: How do I switch between collections?
answer: Use the dropdown in the top-right corner of the header. Select a collection to manage it. The sidebar and all pages will show data for the selected collection.

question: What is the OrgID?
answer: OrgID is your unique organization identifier. It's the same as the owner's user ID. You can find it in My Profile → Organization Details or in the admin Organizations table.

question: Is my data available in Telugu?
answer: UI labels and navigation are available in Telugu (తెలుగు). Switch from My Profile → Language. Your actual data (customer names, addresses, amounts) stays as entered — only the interface changes.

question: How do I import a collection from XLSX export?
answer: Go to New Collection → Import Existing Collection → enter a collection name → configure collection type and settings → upload the XLSX file → click Test to validate → click Import to create.
